issues.issue: The page does not say whether 'Debt Service: Other' is principal or interest; 'debt service interest' is a guess (marked review). By analogy with the budget-form rule for combined bond P&I, 'debt service principal' would be at least as defensible.

Unidentified 'Local Receipts: Other' is about 72% of 2024-25 receipts (excluding transfers), against 29,695 the year before and 25,550 budgeted. It coincides with 143,669 of capital improvements, so it may be a grant or donation, but nothing on the form says so. 'other' is acceptable under the rules (marked review), but this line decides the entity's revenue mix.
